title: PowerStrike2
description: Bakugan Gauntlets and Ability Cards mod. This is a PORT(REMAKE) of the original (abandoned) one from Fabric 1.20.1 to Neoforge 1.21.1(and higher)
body:
### Description
This is my port of the PowerStrike mod. It adds the six gauntlets from the Bakugan anime and ability cards which you can use to fight in a new way.

Ability cards can give some buffs to you and\or debuffs to your opponent while you attack them or have special effects(Gauntlet can shoot with fireballs).

Gauntlets can be switched into sword mode by shift-right-clicking them in your offhand. Some abilities may only apply to either the base or sword mode of your gauntlet.

Currently adds all 6 gauntlets and 10 total ability cards(4 for Pyrus, 2 for Ventus and 4 for Darkus).

Most likely there won`t be a Fabric 1.21.1 version. Please use Neoforge version and Kilt(or something similar).

### To be added:

I really don't know if I'll develop this mod, but if yes, I`ll _(try to)_ add everything what original author planned to.

### Known issues:

- Incompatible for Neoforge version 21.1.233 - I`m working on.

### Credits:

**-Mod logic:** completely developed (recovered) by me, thanks to MCreator

**-Textures:** Pyrus, Ventus, Darkus Gauntlets, Ability Cards - thanks to ThePhroge13, another gauntlets - redesign by me

**-3D Models:** ThePhroge13

**-Icon of the mod:** ThePhroge13
